speaker: Doctor
text: I will begin by asking the parents about any maternal infections during pregnancy, such as cytomegalovirus, toxoplasmosis, or rubella, as these can cause neonatal seizures. Could you also tell me if the baby had any difficulty breathing or feeding immediately after birth?

speaker: Patient
text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. The antenatal period was complicated by chorioamnionitis. Apgar scores were 3 and 6 at 1 and 5 minutes, respectively. The patient has become increasingly lethargic over the past 18 hours and experienced a tonic seizure lasting for 25 seconds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of chorioamnionitis and low Apgar scores, neonatal sepsis is highly suspected. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count.
